title: AuditRecord
description: One record of an audit chain (ADR 0069). It is the governance audit's record (ADR 0038: who did what to which governed resource, in which tenant and environment, with what outcome) with a timestamp, a sequence and the hash of the record before it. Nothing else is recorded, so the record is payload-safe by construction. A chain is one JSON Lines stream owned by one writer; each line is one record, and a record's hash is the SHA-256 of its line's exact UTF-8 bytes without the line feed.

ChainId.description: The chain's id: 32 lowercase hex digits, minted by the writer when it opens the chain. Every record of a chain carries the same id.

Sequence.description: The record's position in its chain, from zero, with no gaps.

Timestamp.description: When the writer appended the record.

RecordHash.description: A record hash: the SHA-256 of a record line's UTF-8 bytes, as 64 lowercase hex digits. A chain's first record carries 64 zeros.

RecordKind.description: What the record is evidence of. A governance mutation, refused ones included.

Label.description: A controlled-vocabulary name or an identifier. Never a workflow payload or a secret.

ChainContinuation.description: Carried by the first record of a chain whose writer had an earlier chain: the earlier chain's id and the hash of the last record the writer knows it appended there. A writer opens a new chain when an append fails, since the failed chain's tail is then unknown, and when a chain reaches its record limit.
